additional_bundle.note: Newest accepted render-path bundle at mount time: clickable_slice bundle_live_enriched_CYCLE_38740365477.json (287 decisions, query FR art-102-CP). Older artifact with 0 relations; included as context, NOT part of the promotion rule which applies to the three gate bundles.

alternatives.name: A1_drop_unhydrated
alternatives.spec: Exclude un-hydrated rows from the geometry input (same TF-IDF+SVD+KMeans otherwise).

alternatives.name: A2_language_aware_tfidf
alternatives.spec: A1 + per-language sublinear TF-IDF concatenated (de/fr/it feature blocks) before SVD/KMeans.

alternatives.name: A3_mds_cosine
alternatives.spec: A1 + metric MDS on cosine distance instead of TruncatedSVD(2).

budget.note: QUERY_MAP_MVP 9A: local clustering/projection for 100-300 decisions target < 2 s. Each alternative reports measured wall time; any alternative over budget is rejected.

COHERENCE_QUERY_LANG.definition: Per-cluster share of rows whose language == bundle query language, vs bundle baseline share. Dominant cluster = largest shipped cluster.

COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM.bar: dominant-cluster query-term hit rate >= bundle baseline hit rate
COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM.definition: Share of rows whose body text contains >=1 frozen query-term lexicon entry (casefold substring).

LABEL_CONTENT_FRACTION.definition: Fraction of label terms (all clusters pooled) that are neither stopwords (qmap STOPWORDS) nor BGE/ATF citation fragments (CIT_RE).
LABEL_CONTENT_FRACTION.status: charter-1 frozen bar, restated from charter text (observed ~0.6-0.7 vs >= 0.80)

LABEL_JACCARD.bar: mean pairwise Jaccard between cluster label term sets <= 0.50, and distinct labels == n_clusters
LABEL_JACCARD.definition: Labels must discriminate groups, not repeat the same vocabulary.

OUTLIER_VALIDITY.bar: PASS iff (outlier mean shared-citation degree < non-outlier mean) AND (Jaccard(outliers, bottom-decile-by-rank) < 1.0). DEGENERATE->FAIL if citation graph empty (degree_degenerate flag read from artifact).
OUTLIER_VALIDITY.definition: Outliers are weakly connected decisions worth inspecting, not merely the rank tail.
OUTLIER_VALIDITY.status: charter-1 concept; bar frozen pre-measurement, degenerate status read from artifact (RF2)

PROJ_KNN10.definition: Mean kNN@10 overlap between 2-D Euclidean neighborhoods and TF-IDF cosine neighborhoods (shipped x/y).

PROJ_RANK.definition: Spearman correlation between distance-to-query-vector (TF-IDF cosine) and retrieval rank (shipped x/y geometry).
PROJ_RANK.status: charter-1 frozen bar, restated from charter text (charter-1 rho ~0.15, RF1 RANK_FIDELITY 0.170 vs 0.30)

PROJ_SPEARMAN.definition: Spearman between shipped 2-D Euclidean distances and TF-IDF cosine distances over sampled pairs.

RELATIONS.bar: edge count >= 10 AND >= 90% of edge endpoints exist as bundle rows AND every edge carries kind
RELATIONS.definition: Relation edges are real (endpoints in the rendered set), typed and reachable on selection.

STRUCTURE_LARGEST.definition: No single group may swallow the map (charter-1 mega-cluster 0.819 failed; current 0.341-0.557).

STRUCTURE_SEP.definition: Mean intra-cluster cosine distance / mean inter-cluster cosine distance (TF-IDF, shipped assignment).

decisive_ablation.artifact_rule: ARTIFACT_TRUE iff (un-hydrated fraction of shipped dominant cluster >= 0.40) AND (hydrated-only recompute largest share differs by >= 0.10 from shipped largest share OR dominant-member Jaccard < 0.5). Cause beyond this boolean is reported UNKNOWN unless separately measured (RF3).
decisive_ablation.definition: Every coherence/separation/projection number computed twice: all rows vs hydrated-only rows (detail_status==search_hit AND full_text_status!=lazy AND language not null). Hydrated-only geometry recomputed with identical vendored qmap-equivalent pipeline.
decisive_ablation.unhydrated_definition: detail_status != 'search_hit' OR full_text_status == 'lazy' OR language is null

non_vacuity.control: Permute cluster_id assignment across rows (seed 0) and permute label texts across cluster ids; recompute all criteria. Identical otherwise.
non_vacuity.required: Corrupted geometry must flip >= 2 criteria verdicts (passed=true). Each non-vacuity number attached to its control; flips reported per control (RF4).

overall_verdict: Per bundle: PASS iff ALL of COHERENCE_QUERY_LANG, COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM, PROJ_RANK, PROJ_SPEARMAN, PROJ_KNN10, STRUCTURE_LARGEST, STRUCTURE_SEP, LABEL_CONTENT_FRACTION, LABEL_JACCARD, OUTLIER_VALIDITY, RELATIONS pass. Any FAIL => bundle FAIL. Promotion rule applies to the three gate bundles. Ablation ARTIFACT_TRUE/FALSE reported alongside, decisive for the one-sentence decision.

provenance.algorithm_reference: Accepted product geometry: product/query/qmap.py build_map (TF-IDF max_features=5000, token len>=2, sublinear_tf, max_df=0.9, stopwords list; TruncatedSVD(2) random_state=42 + axis canonicalisation + max-abs normalisation; KMeans n_clusters=max(2,min(8,n//12+1)) random_state=42 n_init=10; labels top-5 positive-mean TF-IDF terms; outliers = top decile by centroid distance, n>=10) at accepted head 1668181a as mounted for run 38839351403. Harness vendors an equivalent pipeline for recompute/ablation; primary verdict metrics use SHIPPED x/y/cluster/label fields.
provenance.prohibitions: No threshold edit after a number is seen (invalidates run, must be declared). No hand-written frozen_at_utc as evidence; freeze ordering from git commit times. Promoted sentence machine-checked against emitted numbers. No mechanism asserted beyond what is measured.
provenance.recompute_note: Primary metrics read SHIPPED bundle fields (the gate renders these). recompute_vs_shipped agreement (largest-share delta, label overlap) reported as sanity only, not a pass criterion.
